lines.cyr: Љубов ми си ти, младост ми си ти,
lines.lat: Ljubov mi si ti, mladost mi si ti,
lines.en: You are my love, you are my youth,
beautiful song,

lines.cyr: јас без тебе знај не можам.
lines.lat: jas bez tebe znaj ne možam.
lines.en: I cannot live without you, know that.

lines.cyr: Радост ми си ти, тага ми си ти,
lines.lat: Radost mi si ti, taga mi si ti,
lines.en: You are my joy, you are my sorrow,
beautiful song,

lines.cyr: што и да си, ти моја си.
lines.lat: što i da si, ti moja si.
lines.en: whatever you are, you are mine.
I love you, Macedonian song, Macedonian,
you are my love, Macedonian song.
I love you, Macedonian song, Macedonian,
you are my youth, Macedonian song.
